results.fact: Line of the route: descent_text/beta/itinerary go via the Crescent Lake basin and ~3.5 mi of Nason Ridge Trail, but waypoints put the Mastiff boot path ~1 mi past the Merritt junction
results.evidence: descent_text routes back via the Howard-Mastiff saddle and the Crescent Lake basin, then 'roughly three and a half miles east' on the Nason Ridge Trail to the Merritt junction, whereas the waypoints and approach_variants use an unsigned boot path that leaves the Nason Ridge Trail about a mile past the Merritt junction toward Mastiff's south slopes (summit 4.5 mi one-way). Crescent Lake lies ~3.5 mi west of Merritt Lake, beyond Mastiff, so that leg fits a Howard/Crescent approach, not the waypoint line. Not researched to two sources; flagged only.

results.correct_value: about 6.4 mi round trip (3.2 mi one-way) to the summit; the Lake Valhalla side trip adds roughly a mile
